svg.title: Chronic pain: pain over 3 months is mostly a processing problem, so everyone gets education and supervised exercise first; then the drug is matched to what the pain looks like (tissue source, neuropathic, poor sleep, low mood), adjuvants come before opioids, and a patient who is not responding is referred and gets an opioid trial only under the START principle
